features: Final product is a linear turquoise/orange-red/turquoise DNA trace, labelled DNA.

The physical readout carrier is amplified genomic ligation-product DNA: partner identity is associated with a fixed region of interest through the captured DNA junction, not through a sequenced protein or RNA intermediate.
The card reports sequencing after PCR, but no sequencing operation, adapter construction or read layout is drawn.
Partner sequences support a contact profile relative to the selected site. They do not by themselves establish functional regulation or a molecular distance.
The catalogue claims base-pair resolution of ligated fragments. Sequence or junction precision must be distinguished from the physical resolution of the original chromatin contact.
